tools.name: create_building
tools.description: Create a new building for this ועד בית account.

tools.name: add_apartment
tools.description: Add an apartment to a building in this ועד בית account.

tools.name: update_tenant
tools.description: Replace the tenant contact on an apartment. This overwrites the current tenant.

tools.name: backup_building
tools.description: Exports the full building data as JSON that can be restored from the website settings page. Use before bulk changes. The response is the exact backup JSON the website restore accepts and can be large.

tools.name: list_buildings
tools.description: List the buildings this ועד בית account can open, with the caller's role in each one.

tools.name: list_apartments
tools.description: List apartments in a building. Contact details (email, phone) are left out unless includeContacts is true, and then only for callers who may manage that building.

tools.name: record_payment
tools.description: Record a payment for an apartment. Defaults to status COMPLETED paid today. For prepayment of several months pass startDate and endDate (YYYY-MM); the debt calculation covers every month in that range.

tools.name: create_expense
tools.description: Record a building expense (הוצאה). A second call records another expense.

tools.name: update_payment
tools.description: Update an existing payment. Only supplied fields change. startDate and endDate cover whole months; when only one is supplied, the existing other bound is reused. Setting status to COMPLETED generates a receipt number when needed.

tools.name: update_expense
tools.description: Update an existing building expense. Only supplied fields change. At least one of amount, description, date, category, vendor, or invoiceNumber is required. Pass null for vendor or invoiceNumber to clear it.

tools.name: attach_expense_receipt
tools.description: Attach or replace the receipt or invoice file of an existing expense, and optionally set vendor and invoiceNumber. Send either fileBase64 with mimeType (PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 3 MB) or an https url (up to 10 MB, public hosts only, no redirects). The file is stored like receipts uploaded in the app.

tools.name: analyze_debts_and_generate_reminders
tools.description: Analyze apartment debt. Monthly dues are due on the building's dues day (duesDueDay in building settings, 10 unless changed). asOfDate defaults to today in the building's time zone (timezone in building settings) and splits overdue from dueSoon. The response echoes timezone and dueDay. Reminders tar

tools.name: generate_financial_report
tools.description: Generate a financial report for a building. summary.outstanding is overdue debt as of endDate, from the same calculation as analyze_debts_and_generate_reminders. Monthly dues are due on the building's dues day (duesDueDay in building settings, 10 unless changed), so the current month is dueSoon unti

tools.name: get_fund_balance
tools.description: כמה כסף יש בקופה. Calculated balance is the opening balance plus payments received minus expenses since the opening balance date. Also returns the last bank-synced balance when an imported transaction includes a balance field. The two figures are labeled separately and are not added together.

tools.name: list_payments
tools.description: List payments (גבייה) for a building. Optional from and to dates filter the due date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: list_expenses
tools.description: List expenses (הוצאות) for a building. Optional from and to dates filter the expense date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: query_audit_history
tools.description: Read the change log for a building: who changed an apartment, a payment, or an expense.

tools.name: import_bank_statement
tools.description: Import a JSON or PDF bank statement (base64, up to 3 MB). tools.name: list_unmatched_transactions
tools.description: List pending bank transactions and their best payment or expense match candidates. Bank import tools are available only when a building has bank sync configured.

tools.name: reconcile_transaction
tools.description: Match, create and match, or ignore a pending bank transaction. Matching to an existing payment marks it paid and replaces its paid date, method, and reference with the bank line. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_apartments · Private data: update_tenant, list_apartments, record_payment, create_expense, attach_expense_receipt, import_bank_statement, reconcile_transaction · Public sink: list_apartments, attach_expense_receipt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_apartments · Private data: update_tenant, list_apartments, record_payment, create_expense, attach_expense_receipt, import_bank_statement, reconcile_transaction · Public sink: list_apartments, attach_expense_receipt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
